title: ChainFlow: Few-Step Latent Flow Matching for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.08669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding has become a standard way to accelerate LLM inference: a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target verifies in one parallel pass. Existing drafters face trade-offs that limits their speedups: autoregressive drafters generate tokens one at a time, so drafting cost grows with draft length, while diffusion drafters generate tokens in parallel but predict each position independently, ignoring inter-token dependencies. We introduce ChainFlow, a new speculative decoding paradigm and the first flow-matching drafter conditioned on the target's hidden states. ChainFlow treats drafting as a short transport over hidden states, needing one or two flow steps instead of the many denoising steps of generation from noise. A variational autoencoder compresses these states so drafting cost barely grows with target size, lightweight feedback heads restore inter-token dependencies, and tree drafting raises acceptance. translated_title: ChainFlow：用于投机解码的少步潜空间流匹配
translated_abstract: 投机解码已成为加速大语言模型推理的标准方法：轻量级草稿模型提出若干token，目标模型通过一次并行前向传播进行验证。现有草稿模型面临限制其加速效果的权衡：自回归草稿模型逐个生成token，草稿成本随草稿长度增长；扩散草稿模型虽可并行生成token，但独立预测每个位置，忽略了token间的依赖关系。我们提出ChainFlow，一种新的投机解码范式，也是首个以目标模型隐状态为条件的流匹配草稿模型。ChainFlow将草稿生成视为隐状态上的短程传输，只需一或两步流步骤，而无需像从噪声生成那样进行多次去噪。变分自编码器压缩这些状态，使草稿成本几乎不随目标模型规模增长；轻量级反馈头恢复token间的依赖关系；树形草稿机制则提高了接受率。在Qwe
tldr: ChainFlow提出首个以目标模型隐状态为条件的流匹配草稿模型，通过一至两步的潜空间短程传输生成草稿，使草稿成本几乎不随目标模型规模增长，同时兼顾并行生成与token间依赖。
en_tdlr: ChainFlow introduces the first flow-matching drafter conditioned on the target's hidden states, using one or two short latent transport steps so drafting cost barely grows with target model size while preserving inter-token dependencies.
